title: Count with do
summary: Fortran: Count with do. Count to 4. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: A counted do loop includes both its start and end values. Read the example, then check the result.

blocks.text: Install GNU Fortran. Save each example as lesson.f90, run gfortran -std=f2008 lesson.f90 -o lesson, then run it.

blocks.title: Count with do
blocks.code:
program lesson
  implicit none
integer :: n
do n = 1, 3
 write(*,'(I0)') n
end do
end program lesson

blocks.text: The do counter takes 1, 2 and 3, including both range ends.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Do not change the loop counter inside the counted loop.
